summary.text: Carolyn Caton is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 33 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat Troy Latterell is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Carolyn Caton was born in Kansas City, Missouri, and graduated from Blue Springs High School in 1984.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Baker University in 1996 and a graduate degree from the University of Evansville in 2004.
Her career experience includes work in the transportation industry and logistics.
Caton was assigned to the House Administration and Accounts, Professional Registration and Licensing, and Transportation committees for 2025-2026.
